title: Carrots to Strawberries!
description: Turns the boring carrots to Strawberries!
body:
Turns the boring carrots to Strawberries!

This Texture pack changes Carrots, Golden Carrots, and the Carrot on a stick to a strawberry themed counterpart!

This is my First texture pack so please don't think too harshly of it.

There are known issues with certain mods like Jade and WTHIT. And might be fixed later if I learn how.
